语音朗读
AI字幕
字幕控制

如何配置朗读控件的后台长时任务保持后台播报正常？
如何切换朗读控件的音色？
如何在PC/2in1设备上适配朗读控件？

当你的应用需要将文字内容转为语音朗读时使用朗读控件，例如新闻类应用为用户提供听新闻功能、阅读类应用支持文章朗读等场景
当你的应用需要为音频内容提供实时字幕时使用AI字幕控件，例如视频会议、外语学习、静音环境下的音频理解等场景
当需要配置朗读控件的后台播放、音色切换等高级功能时，需要在module.json5中添加相应权限（如后台长时任务权限、网络权限等）
为文章内容添加后台持续播报的文字转语音功能 / Add text-to-speech playback for articles that continues in the background
集成 TextReader 朗读长文本并支持暂停继续和进度控制 / Integrate TextReader for long-form reading with pause, resume, and progress control
实现多音色多语种的内容朗读切换 / Implement content readout switching across voices and languages
给新闻或电子书页面接入一键听读功能 / Add one-tap listen-to-article playback to news or ebook pages
把应用内文本消息转换成语音播放 / Convert in-app text messages into spoken audio
为直播或音频播放页显示实时 AI 字幕 / Show real-time AI captions on a live stream or audio playback page
向 AICaptionComponent 持续写入 PCM 音频流生成字幕 / Feed PCM audio continuously into AICaptionComponent to generate captions
实现字幕层的显示、隐藏和位置控制 / Implement caption overlay show, hide, and position control
给会议记录或课程音频添加边播边出字幕能力 / Add live captions while playing meeting recordings or course audio
接入语音播报让无障碍阅读更自然 / Integrate spoken reading to make accessibility reading more natural
在 PC 和 2in1 设备上适配朗读与字幕组件体验 / Adapt speech reading and caption components for PC and 2-in-1 devices
管理语音朗读的后台任务避免切到后台后中断 / Manage background speech tasks so playback does not stop when the app goes to background
do_not_use_when: 需求是做OCR文字识别、人脸检测与比对、主体分割、多目标识别或17点人体姿态分析，应改用 core-vision-kit / The task is OCR text recognition, face detection and comparison, subject segmentation, multi-object recognition, or 17-point human pose analysis; use core-vision-kit instead

需求是卡证OCR、文档扫描自动裁剪、人脸活体检测或识图搜索等视觉功能，应改用 vision-kit / The requirement is visual features such as card/document OCR, document scan auto-cropping, face liveness detection, or image-based search; use vision-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成Speech Kit对应SDK能力，且目标设备为Phone、Tablet或PC/2in1 / The project has integrated the Speech Kit SDK capability, and the target device is Phone, Tablet, or PC/2in1

使用朗读控件高级能力时，module.json5中已声明所需权限（如网络权限、后台长时任务权限） / When using advanced TextReader capabilities, required permissions are declared in module.json5 (such as network and long-running background task permissions)
使用AI字幕控件时，可提供符合要求的音频流：PCM、16000采样率、单声道、16位位深 / When using the AI caption component, a compliant audio stream is available: PCM, 16 kHz, mono, 16-bit
在PC/2in1上使用朗读控件时，已完成子Ability创建和固定窗口大小等适配 / When using the reading component on PC/2in1, sub-Ability creation and fixed window size adaptation are already completed
inputs: 待朗读的文本内容 / text content to be read aloud
PCM音频流数据 / PCM audio stream data
字幕或朗读组件的界面配置参数 / UI configuration parameters for caption or reading components
音色、播放控制或显示隐藏等控件参数 / control parameters such as voice timbre, playback, or show/hide state
outputs: TextReader朗读控件实例 / TextReader reading component instance
文本转语音后的中文朗读音频播放 / Chinese text-to-speech audio playback
朗读播放状态、进度与错误事件回调数据 / Text reading playback state, progress, and error event callback data
AICaptionComponent AI字幕控件实例 / AICaptionComponent AI caption component instance
中英文实时字幕识别文本 / Real-time Chinese and English caption recognition text
AI字幕显示或隐藏后的字幕渲染视图 / Rendered caption view after AI caption show or hide control

postconditions.statement: 工程中已接入并初始化TextReader或AICaptionComponent中的至少一种语音场景化控件 / The project integrates and initializes at least one scenario-based speech component: TextReader or AICaptionComponent
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify HarmonyOS code to create, initialize, or use either TextReader or AICaptionComponent?

postconditions.statement: 若实现AI字幕，代码中已按要求处理PCM 16kHz 单声道 16位音频输入或明确校验该格式 / If AI captions are implemented, the code handles or explicitly validates PCM 16kHz mono 16-bit audio input as required
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the changes implement AI captions, do they show audio input handling or validation consistent with PCM, 16000 Hz, mono, 16-bit requirements?

postconditions.statement: 若实现朗读增强能力，相关权限或后台播放配置已在工程文件中补充 / If enhanced reading features are implemented, the necessary permissions or background playback configuration are added to project files
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the changes add TextReader background playback or similar advanced features, do the edits also include corresponding permission or configuration updates such as in module.json5?
